result.summary: Adds a constructor to CTransaction that accepts input ranges of CTxIn and CTxOut, and extends CTxIn constructors with an optional script witness parameter. It introduces RangeOf and ToVector helpers in util/vector.h, and demonstrates declarative transaction construction in sigopcount_tests.
result.problem: Creating an immutable CTransaction currently requires initializing and modifying an intermediate CMutableTransaction, which adds boilerplate code when constructing test fixtures.
evidence: Part of #36692 (Declarative construction of test data) and referenced by #36694 (test, bench: construct mempool inputs/outputs declaratively)
result.changed_since_previous: Diff is now available, showing changes isolated to transaction primitives, vector utility helpers, and sigopcount_tests.
result.card: CTransaction gains a constructor taking generic ranges of inputs and outputs directly, and CTxIn constructors gain an optional script witness parameter. This allows declarative construction of immutable transactions without round-tripping through CMutableTransaction. The change is part of tracking issue #36692 and provides constructor primitives used by test cleanups like #36694.

risk.why: Touches core transaction primitive constructors and hash computations; flawed construction logic or invariant breakage could corrupt transaction data or hashing.
